parsed.explanation: Despite 1976 decriminalisation, indecency/morality Articles 324, 329, 350 are documented as an operative arrest lever against LGBTQI+ and cross-dressing people, carrying 3 months-2 years' imprisonment, fines and deportation for non-citizens. Documented raids, a conviction for cross-dressing, Interior Minister airport screening/banning of suspected effeminate visitors, pending entry-ban bills, and February 2024 further moral legislation show current organised targeting and universal border exposure. There is no anti-discrimination protection, no LGBTQ organisations, hate speech is unpunished, accusations are used against critics, and 2023 Sharia-based courts refuse gender recognition and care, leaving no remedy. Thin, partly dated sourcing and blocked researchers increase uncertainty, but structural signals extrapolate toward severe, state-directed risk without documented executions or custody torture.
